# telnyx_ota_updates (Data Source)

The over-the-air updates sent to SIM cards.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_sim_card_id` (String) The SIM card identification UUID.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter by a specific status of the resource's lifecycle. One of `completed`, `failed`, `in-progress`.
- `filter_type` (String) Filter by type. One of `sim_card_network_preferences`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ota_updates` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ota_updates))
